rows.note: Use 過 as the all-purpose verb for moving past or across a place and for a period, feeling, or situation coming to an end.

example.english: We pass over the bridge before going to eat.
example.traditional: 我哋行過條橋先去食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 gwo3 tiu4 kiu4 sin1 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for official permission or a document allowing travel or passage, including a travel or military pass.

example.english: You need to show your pass when entering the country.
example.traditional: 入境嗰陣要出示通行證。
example.jyutping: jap6 ging2 go2 zan6 jiu3 ceot1 si6 tung1 haang4 zing3

rows.note: Use this as the ordinary noun for an attempt, such as an attempt at writing.

example.english: My first pass at writing this article was too long.
example.traditional: 我第一次嘗試寫呢篇文，寫得太長。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng4 si3 se2 ni1 pin1 man4 se2 dak1 taai3 coeng4

rows.note: Use 傳畀 when passing an item onward to someone or passing a ball to a teammate.

example.jyutping: nei5 cyun4 bei2 ngo5 go3 bo1 laa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for moving a ball or puck to another player in sport.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 go3 cyun4 kau4 hou2 zeon2

rows.note: Use 過關 for successfully getting through an examination or another approval hurdle, including a bill clearing its stages.

example.english: I finally pass, so I do not need to retake the exam.
example.traditional: 我終於過關喇，唔使再考多次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 gwo3 gwaan1 laa3 m4 sai2 zoi3 haau2 do1 ci3

rows.note: Use 過身 as the ordinary Cantonese euphemism for someone dying.

example.english: Some people eventually pass away peacefully after suffering badly from illness.
example.traditional: 有啲人病得好辛苦，最後都係安詳咁過身。
example.jyutping: jau5 di1 jan4 beng6 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 on1 coeng4 gam2 gwo3 san1

rows.note: Use this for a flirtatious or sexual approach, rather than for an ordinary attempt to start a conversation.

example.english: They made a pass at a girl in the bar and even tried to ask her out.
example.traditional: 佢喺酒吧同個女仔搭訕，仲想約人出去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 zau2 baa1 tung4 go3 neoi5 zai2 daap3 saan3 zung6 soeng2 joek3 jan4 ceot1 heoi3
